incidents.title: APT42 used Gemini for phishing content and defense-expert recon
incidents.targets: Defense experts and a US defense organization
incidents.outcome: Google reports misuse; no breach attributed to the Gemini use in the report.
incidents.confidenceReason: Google observed the group's Gemini activity directly.
incidents.summary: Iranian APT42 used Gemini to research individual policy and defense experts, craft tailored phishing material, and research public vulnerabilities in products like Mikrotik, Apereo and Atlassian.
incidents.quote: APT42's Gemini activity reflected the group's focus on crafting successful phishing campaigns.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Google Threat Intelligence Group has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

harness.note: AI used as a chatbot/assistant, no agent harness

incidents.title: APT43 uses public AI chatbots and image generators for research and lure material
incidents.outcome: GTIG saw the tools accessed; it says the intended purpose is not clear.
incidents.confidenceReason: GTIG detected APT43 accessing public LLM and image tools and infers research use; it says the intended purpose is not clear.
incidents.summary: Split from GTIG's January 2025 report on nine North Korean groups: GTIG detected APT43 accessing several public AI chatbots, including for research on South Korean military and nuclear affairs, and AI image tools that make realistic human portraits.
incidents.quote: GTIG has identified APT43 actors accessing multiple publicly available AI image generation tools, including tools used for image manipulation and creating realistic-looking human portraits.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Google Threat Intelligence Group has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

incidents.title: French TV show pulled after ridicule of woman who fell for AI Brad Pitt
incidents.outcome: A French woman lost about EUR 830,000.
incidents.confidenceReason: The Guardian body never says the images were AI-made; 'AI' appears only in the headline. The victim's TV account is quoted but does not cover AI. Thin.
incidents.summary: Scammers posing as Brad Pitt sent a French woman AI-generated images, including pictures of him apparently in hospital, to get money for supposed kidney treatment.
incidents.quote: She then received AI-generated pictures of the actor apparently in hospital, with requests to her to pay for his kidney treatment.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only The Guardian has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

incidents.title: Deepfake of DNB's CFO and CEO in a live Teams meeting targets the bank's Singapore office
incidents.outcome: DNB's Singapore office avoided any loss.
incidents.confidenceReason: DNB staff saw the live Teams meeting with deepfaked video and voice of the CFO and CEO, and DNB called it "their first encounter with a live deepfake meeting". The AI Incident Database relays this first-hand account, which is Strong.
incidents.summary: Fraudsters used deepfake video and voice of DNB's CFO and CEO, per DNB, in a live Microsoft Teams meeting to ask the bank's Singapore office to transfer millions of Singapore dollars.
incidents.quote: Unknown cybercriminals reportedly used purported deepfakes to impersonate DNB Bank's CFO and CEO during a live Microsoft Teams meeting, instructing employees at the bank's Singapore office to transfer millions of Singapore dollars.
incidents.singleSourceReason: This operation reaches the ledger only through AI Incident Database's record; the 2026-11-17 sweep found no other publisher.

incidents.title: Hong Kong syndicate used AI deepfake video calls in dating-platform crypto fraud (31 arrested, 14 prosecuted)
incidents.targets: Victims in Taiwan, Singapore and Malaysia (HK$34 million)
incidents.outcome: About HK$34 million lost; 31 arrested and 14 prosecuted.
incidents.confidenceReason: Hong Kong police describe the deepfake calls; the statement reaches us through The Standard.
incidents.summary: A syndicate used AI-generated images, videos and deepfake video calls on dating platforms to draw victims into crypto investment fraud; police arrested 31 in January 2025 and charged more in February 2026.
incidents.quote: The group employed AI-generated images and videos and, in some cases, conducted video calls using deepfake technology to impersonate victims’ contacts.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only The Standard has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

incidents.title: Japanese teen arrested for breaching Kaikatsu Frontier with an AI-generated program
incidents.targets: Kaikatsu Frontier (internet cafe operator), up to 7.3 million customer records
incidents.outcome: Member data at the internet-cafe chain Kaikatsu Frontier was exposed; the suspect was arrested.
incidents.confidenceReason: The AI claim rests on Kyodo citing an unnamed "investigative source" ("a program generated by a conversational artificial intelligence"), relayed by the AI Incident Database. An anonymous source makes the grade Suspected.
incidents.summary: Police say a 17-year-old breached Kaikatsu Frontier with a program generated by a conversational AI tool, hiding his intent when prompting it.
incidents.quote: A 17-year-old boy in Osaka was reportedly served an arrest warrant for allegedly breaching Kaikatsu Frontier's server using a program purportedly generated with a conversational AI tool.
incidents.singleSourceReason: This operation reaches the ledger only through AI Incident Database's record; the 2026-11-17 sweep found no other publisher.

incidents.title: Vidoc Security interviews two deepfake job candidates
incidents.outcome: Blocked; second candidate confronted and recorded, no hire made.
incidents.confidenceReason: The victim shows evidence: the co-founder recorded the second interview and published the video ("Yes, this is a real recording, it happened today"). He is quoted on the record by The Register. The first candidate is only "almost certainly using an AI filter"; the grade rests on the recorded one.
incidents.summary: Two applicants hid behind deepfake avatars; the company nearly gave an offer to the first and caught the second live.
incidents.quote: two imposters hiding behind deepfake avatars almost succeeded in tricking your startup into hiring them

harness.note: Deepfake/impersonation tool only, no agent harness
